北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗但寒冷，体感 -2℃，注意保暖，多喝水哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Beijing but feels like -2℃. Stay warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力 5级，体感 -2℃，多云天更要穿厚点，小心着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Cixi with strong winds, feels like -2℃. Bundle up to avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，气温 3℃ 左右，体感微凉。记得添衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Shanghai, around 3℃, feels cool. Remember to add layers!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴好但风力 4级，体感 9℃，早晚出门别忘了加件外套。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Guangzhou with winds, feels like 9℃. Remember a jacket for morning/evening.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳风力 5级，体感 9℃，晴天也别大意，注意防风保暖。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Shenzhen with strong winds, feels like 9℃. Don't underestimate the chill, stay warm!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 5级

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 0℃，注意防寒保暖，别冻着了。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Hangzhou feels like 0℃. Take care and keep warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，体感 -1℃，出门记得穿暖和点哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Nanjing feels like -1℃. Remember to dress warmly when you go out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100%，出门小心湿滑，别忘了带伞。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Overcast Chengdu with 100% humidity. Be careful of slippery surfaces and bring an umbrella.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，体感 1℃。多穿点，注意防寒，别感冒了。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and chilly Wuhan, feels like 1℃. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷，体感 -5℃，湿度 100%，务必多穿，小心路滑！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and very cold Xi'an, feels like -5℃ with 100% humidity. Dress warmly and watch for slippery roads!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阵雨，体感 4℃。出门记得带雨具，注意保暖别淋湿。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Showers in Chongqing, feels like 4℃. Bring an umbrella and keep warm and dry.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 -15℃，体感 -20℃！天寒地冻，务必全副武装防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin at -15℃, feels like -20℃! Extremely cold, bundle up completely to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗但 -11℃，体感 -16℃，务必防寒，暖宝宝安排上！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Shenyang at -11℃, feels like -16℃. Stay warm, consider a hand warmer!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 9℃，风力 4级，早晚温差大，注意添减衣物。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Kunming, feels like 9℃ with winds. Mind the big temperature difference, add/remove layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 10℃，风力 4级，出门加件外套，别着凉哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Xiamen, feels like 10℃ with winds. Wear a jacket when going out to avoid a chill.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力 5级，体感 -9℃！多云天寒，务必穿厚实，小心感冒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Qingdao with strong winds, feels like -9℃! Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗但 -4℃，体感 -8℃，出门记得多穿点，别冻着了。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Dalian at -4℃, feels like -8℃. Remember to dress warmly when you go out.
